euAiAct.schemaDescription: Overview of EU AI Act compliance themes including risk classification, technical documentation, transparency obligations, and post-market monitoring.
euAiAct.title: EU AI Act
euAiAct.subtitle: European AI regulation framework
euAiAct.intro: This page outlines key elements of the EU AI Act to help teams frame control design, evidence collection, and compliance-readiness workstreams.

items.secondary: Identify prohibited, high-risk, and limited-risk use cases and apply the correct obligations.
Prepare robust documentation, logs, and traceability artifacts for regulatory scrutiny.
Provide clear user-facing disclosures when interacting with AI systems.
Track incidents, maintain reporting readiness, and continuously evaluate model behavior.
